column1: # techneissa's fork: interface text for fork features, added to craft-i18n's locales/zh-hans/photocraft.tsv at build time (crates/ui-egui/fork_i18n.rs). Rows the official catalog already has are dropped.

column2: Models are optional and run entirely on this computer. Downloading fetches the model file from Hugging Face; no images or documents are ever uploaded. Without a model, Select Subject, Remove Background and Remove Subject use the built-in (non-AI) methods.
column3: 模型为可选项，完全在本机运行。下载时会从 Hugging Face 获取模型文件，绝不会上传任何图像或文档。未安装模型时，“选择主体”“移除背景”和“移除主体”使用内置的非 AI 方法。
模型下载工作线程失败。
